entries.land_location_as_stated: large island in a small town off the coast of Maine
entries.description: A guest house on a large island off the coast of Maine, offering 3 rooms. Home to 2 lesbians.
entries.raw_text: SEA GNOMES' HOME PO Box 33, Stonington, ME 04681 (207)367-5076. Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms at reasonable rates. Seasonal - June thru Sept. Situated on a large island in a small town off the coast of Maine. No bars, no TV, no swimming pool (though there is a lake near). Just a quiet retreat in a beautiful place. We are: 2 lesbians.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it calls itself a 'quiet retreat' and 'Womyn's Guest House offering 3 rooms'. Land state inferred as ME from contact state and description of coast of Maine.

entries.description: An 18-acre community in Maine with fields, woods, and farm animals. Welcomes non-lesbian women. Focuses on farming/self-sufficiency and environmentalism/eco-friendly.
entries.raw_text: LAUREL RIDGE RFD 2 Box 277, Lincolnville, ME 04849 (207)338-1913 (Northport, ME). Laurel Ridge is a guest house for women on 18 beautiful acres of fields and woods in the heart of Mid-Coast Maine, where the mountains meet the sea. Our rates are very reasonable and our guests enjoy comfortable lodging and delicious home-cooked meals. There are domestic and farm animals about the place, as well as vegetable, herb, and flower gardens. Partial work exchange possible. Open year round. We welcome: non-lesbian women. No drugs or alcohol. We have/are: 18 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it states 'women living and working on the land' and 'We welcome: non-lesbian women'. Accepted groups include Non-lesbian women as explicitly stated. Focuses include Farming/self-sufficiency ('vegetable, herb, and flower gardens', 'domestic and farm animals', 'farmland') and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('No drugs or alcohol', working the land). Land location is Northport, ME as explicitly noted in parentheses after phone number.

entries.description: A 2-acre vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains of Pennsylvania, accommodating 7 persons. Home to 2 lesbians and welcomes non-lesbian women, children, and men.
entries.raw_text: HALF MOON PINES c/o Barbara Hart, RD #1 Box 1446, Hamburg, PA 19526 (215)373-5697. Vacation cabin in the Blue Mountains. 3-4 bedrooms which accommodate 7 persons, huge, cozy kitchen and enclosed porch. The cabin is in a private setting in the State Game Lands, one mile down from the Appalachian Trail and a short distance from Blue Marsh Recreation Area and PA Dutch Country. Rates $225/week, $150/weekend, $50/day. We welcome: new residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it is described as a 'Vacation cabin' with rates per week/weekend/day. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl & boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('males').

entries.description: A lesbian residential community in St. Augustine, Florida, featuring separately owned cottages, a cultural/spiritual center, feminist library, and health food store. Home to 15 resident lesbians and 90 lesbian/non-lesbian members nationwide. Welcomes non-lesbian women and girl children.
entries.raw_text: PAGODA 207 Coastal Hwy, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small lesbian residential community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in building. No pets, no nudity on our property or directly in front of us on the beach. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We have/are: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('lesbian residential community'). Number of residents: 15 resident lesbians. Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women visitors'), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Archives/cultural work ('feminist library'), Workshops/education ('cultural/spiritual center').

entries.land_location_as_stated: northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan
entries.description: An all-woman wilderness resort and community in northwest Michigan with 3 cabins near Long Lake. Home to 2 lesbians. Welcomes non-lesbian women and children under 12.
entries.raw_text: LABRYS c/o Nell Wagenaar & Rebecca Clark, Rt 1 Box 257, Honor, MI 49640 (618)882-5994 (4115 M-22). Labrys is an inexpensive, synergetic wilderness resort for women located in northwest Michigan a mile from Lake Michigan. We have three cabins nestled among tall White Pine and Oak facing a sandy beach on Long Lake with dock and boats. We are looking for women to invest in property here. Our dream is to make this end of Long Lake an all-woman community, with a possible campground, a quiet area for geese and heron nesting, more cabins and a community lodge for workshops, etc. Open year round. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children under 12, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 1 acre, 3 cabins, plumbing/electricity, woods, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative ('women living and working on the land', looking for members to build an all-woman community). Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl children, boy children under 12'). Land street address explicitly given as 4115 M-22 in parentheses.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis
entries.description: A scenic retreat on the Illinois River in Kampsville, Illinois, catering to women and lesbians. Home to 4 lesbians and 14 acres. Welcomes non-lesbian women, children, and men.
entries.raw_text: RIVER SPIRIT RETREAT 187 W 19th St, Alton, IL 62002 (618)462-4051 or 653-4349 (retreat) or (314)773-3867 (St Louis). Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL, 1 hr from Alton, 2 hrs from St Louis. River Spirit Retreat is a scenic, secluded retreat for individuals and small groups by the Illinois River. Retreat caters to women, especially lesbians. Open to alternative humanitarian types, counselors or small businesses needing retreat atmosphere. Proprietor is counselor and offers groups and retreats several times a year. We welcome: new members/residents, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 14 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, camping space, women living part-time and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space ('scenic, secluded retreat'). Land city is Kampsville, IL as stated ('Located Rt 100 North of Kampsville, IL'). Accepted groups: Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl & boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('males'). Residents: 4 lesbians (noted as living part-time and working on the land).
